device_entry.name: Sunpower CryoTel GT 低温制冷机
tags: 低温制冷与低温实验支撑
device_entry.description: Sunpower CryoTel GT 系列闭循环低温制冷设备（含控制器），用于在实验室中为冷台/低温组件提供冷量并将温度稳定在设定值附近。设备可读取当前温度与功率等运行状态，并支持以温度或功率模式进行基本控制与启停管理。
device_entry.description_en: The Sunpower CryoTel GT is a closed-cycle cryocooler (with controller) used in laboratories to provide cooling power for a cold stage/cryogenic assembly and stabilize it near a target temperature. It supports reading operating status such as temperature and power, and basic operation in temperature or power control modes including start/stop control.
